selection: All23 previously selected insufficient/substantive outputs, retaining all13 bases; their denominator is the original60 I, not23 new independent samples.

bases.structural_difference: Same battle, different naming roles; question already contains the returned name.
bases.design_connection: Role distinction is analogous to two fields, but alias/pragmatic naming knowledge is not reproduced.

bases.structural_difference: Named river exists for country; answer adds chief status not supplied by those facts.
bases.design_connection: Candidate is already related to target under a different predicate; direct motivation for TA, without claiming independent code fields reproduce chief-river semantics.

bases.structural_difference: Location belonging to Dingzhou is assigned to Luoding; question requests both cities.
bases.design_connection: Other entity/same attribute is already covered structurally by completed binding48; multi-target question is not reproduced.

bases.structural_difference: Chess-like/strategy description is promoted to a shared game category; old audit retains category-inference ambiguity.
bases.design_connection: Code fields avoid lexical category inference, so this question is outside the new test.

bases.structural_difference: Visible individual-season entries are used for an overview total; old scope ambiguity remains.
bases.design_connection: Single code lookup has no enumeration/overview scope; not tested.

bases.structural_difference: Season1 episode count is returned for season2; entities share a show and are distinguished by season.
bases.design_connection: Other entity/same attribute is old binding48's structural axis, but close names and long tabular backgrounds differ.

bases.structural_difference: Market-debut year is absent from I; answers add1963 or1958.
bases.design_connection: New design always displays a candidate; it cannot test generation of a value absent from text or its source.

bases.structural_difference: Question contains the meaningful verb ameliorate; answer supplies better absent from documents.
bases.design_connection: Opaque codes remove lexical-semantic knowledge; lexical boundary is not resolved by new design.

bases.structural_difference: Phenomenon or more-apparent condition is presented as cause; one output has cause/modifier ambiguity.
bases.design_connection: Distinguishing relation roles is analogous; no causal/physical relation is tested by code fields.

bases.structural_difference: Columbus as city/largest city in Ohio is promoted to capital; output explicitly acknowledges missing capital evidence.
bases.design_connection: Strong motivation for keeping target/candidate fixed while changing requested predicate; new codes do not reproduce largest/capital knowledge.

bases.structural_difference: Sheila names a record but can also be read as a person in D5; original referent ambiguity remains.
bases.design_connection: Explicit unit IDs remove this name-role ambiguity, so the new test cannot adjudicate the old case.

bases.structural_difference: Based-on Pachisi is used to infer Sorry! game type; missing category bridge and wrong-target acknowledgment remain as audited.
bases.design_connection: No taxonomy or multi-hop inference rule is in the code-field test.

bases.structural_difference: Dish description is present but name is absent; answers supply sushi/sashimi then qualify document support.
bases.design_connection: Always-displayed opaque candidate does not test unseen naming or external semantic completion.

cross_study_dimensions.transfer: All60 I/30 bases;23 answering outputs/13 bases selected afterward for the old audit.
cross_study_dimensions.binding: All24 I/12 synthetic scenarios, not selected by behavior.
cross_study_dimensions.implication: Do not contrast selected23/23 with0/24 or interpret the separate23/60 and0/24 as an intervention effect.

cross_study_dimensions.transfer: Names, years, places, categories, causes, counts; candidate may be absent, salient under another relation, or under another entity.
cross_study_dimensions.binding: Opaque access codes; one target field removed, another unit's access code remains.
cross_study_dimensions.implication: Completed binding48 only tests a narrow cross-entity axis; new TA versus OA adds same-entity/other-attribute attachment.

cross_study_dimensions.transfer: 13 error-selected base questions and30 original I bases; some questions request multiple targets or inference.
cross_study_dimensions.binding: One English lookup template with12 identifier/slot instantiations.
cross_study_dimensions.implication: Neither23 error rows nor48 variants are independent task families.

cross_study_dimensions.transfer: Five slots mixing edited short target facts with long natural/tabular backgrounds; multiple candidate facts may appear.
cross_study_dimensions.binding: Five short fictional records, explicit unit identifiers and one active distractor value.
cross_study_dimensions.implication: Length, density, naming similarity, fact multiplicity and question form covary; no single root cause follows from study contrast.

cross_study_dimensions.transfer: Eight old audited outputs have category, overview, lexical, causal-role or referent boundaries.
cross_study_dimensions.binding: Explicit fictional assignments with two compatible target worlds in I.
cross_study_dimensions.implication: Keep all old unknown/boundary declarations; formal new worlds cannot retroactively certify old judgments.

cross_study_dimensions.transfer: History-exposed author references and behavior judgments.
cross_study_dimensions.binding: History-exposed author references and behavior judgments;48 citation-attribution fields unknown.
cross_study_dimensions.implication: No new independent semantic approval; numeric verification is not independent semantic review.

cross_study_dimensions.transfer: Old chat L28 predicted during collection; reliability unconfirmed.
cross_study_dimensions.binding: Behavior collected without states; old L28 read later from recomputed inputs.
cross_study_dimensions.implication: Behavior-only new primary endpoint; no readout-conditioned claims, fit, calibration or patching.
